title: Evolith Design Block Registry
description: Block-type registry (ADR-0104, GT-428). The canonical catalogue of design-block kinds composable into a blueprint. Convention over Configuration: new blocks are ADDED here (community contributions via UP-NNN) WITHOUT changing the engine. `category`=universal blocks are always scored and always contribute to maturity; `topology-derived` blocks are scored when the confirmed topology composition requires them (DS-10). Every block conforms to design-block.schema.json unless it declares its own refining `schemaRef`.
